title.narrative: Xinjiang Tacheng Border Cities and Counties Development Project

description.narrative: By meeting urgent needs in urban infrastructure and municipal services, the project will improve the environment, social inclusiveness, and border trade capacity of Tacheng City and the county cities of Emin, Tuoli, and Yumin.
